title: DreamHost Review 2026: Pricing, WordPress Plans and Verdict
excerpt: DreamHost Launch is $2.89 a month on a 1-year term and renews at $10.99. Here is what each plan includes, how fast it tested, the nonprofit offer, how to set up WordPress and who should look elsewhere.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: DreamHost Review 2026: Pricing, WordPress Plans and Verdict
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: DreamHost review for 2026: shared and WordPress plan prices, renewals, support and who it suits, with a short guide to installing WordPress on DreamHost.
meta.rl_answer: DreamHost is a low-cost host that allows 25 sites on its cheapest plan. Launch is $2.89 a month on a 1-year term and renews at $10.99. There is no phone support.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is DreamHost a good host? | Yes for bloggers, small businesses and people with several small sites. Launch allows 25 websites with daily backups. The trade-offs are the renewal price, no phone support and speed that trails LiteSpeed hosts.
How much does DreamHost cost? | On DreamHost's pricing page on 20 November 2026, Launch was $2.89 a month on a 1-year term, Growth $3.99 and Scale $9.99. On a 4-year term Launch is $1.99. The full term is charged at checkout.
How much does DreamHost cost after renewal? | Launch renews at $10.99 a month after a 1-year term, or $7.99 after a 4-year term. Growth renews at $12.99 or $8.99, and Scale at $25.99 or $19.99. A longer first term gives a lower renewal.
How many WordPress sites does DreamHost host? | Launch allows 25 websites, Growth 50 and Scale 100. DreamPress, the managed WordPress plan, allows 1 site on DreamPress 1.
Can I use WordPress plugins on DreamHost shared hosting? | Yes. WPSchool ran WordPress with WooCommerce and seven plugins on a DreamHost shared test site for 30 days. Shared plans have no server-level cache, so a caching plugin helps.
Why host WordPress on DreamHost? | The cheapest plan allows 25 sites with NVMe storage and daily backups, and DreamHost shows renewal prices up front.
Is DreamHost fast? | It is average. WPBeginner measured 986 ms Largest Contentful Paint and 658 ms average response in July 2026, behind Hostinger at 659 ms and 227 ms. Hosttest.de measured 0.133 s time to first byte on a Launch plan.
Does DreamHost have a money-back guarantee? | Yes, 30 days on the current plan pages. Some older reviews say 97 days, but they describe plans DreamHost no longer sells to new customers.
Does DreamHost have phone support? | No. Support is 24/7 live chat and tickets. WPRoom says a one-time callback costs $9.95.
Is DreamHost email free? | Only for the first 3 months. Launch includes 20 mailboxes, Growth 40 and Scale 60 in the trial. After that, email costs from $1.67 a month per mailbox on annual billing, according to WPRoom.
Does DreamHost offer free nonprofit hosting? | Not confirmed. DreamHost long offered one free shared plan to US 501(c)(3) and 501(c)(19) nonprofits, but its own nonprofit page returned a 404 in an October 2026 study and several 2026 reports say new sign-ups closed on 31 March 2026. Ask DreamHost support for the current terms.
Does DreamHost have staging and a CDN? | Not on the shared plans. DreamHost says you need DreamPress for Bunny CDN and one-click staging.
Is DreamHost better than Bluehost? | DreamHost allows more sites on its entry plan (25 against 10). In WPBeginner's July 2026 tests it loaded in 986 ms against 933 ms for Bluehost. Bluehost offers phone support on higher plans.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Launch is $2.89 a month on a 1-year term and renews at $10.99 (DreamHost, 20 Nov 2026).
On a 4-year term Launch is $1.99 and renews at $7.99.
Launch allows 25 websites, 25 GB of NVMe storage and daily backups.
The refund window is 30 days. Older reviews that say 97 days describe plans no longer sold.
meta.rl_r_verdict: DreamHost is a good low-cost home for several small WordPress sites. Pick the 4-year term only if you are sure, budget for email after three months, and use the 30-day window to test it. Look elsewhere if you need phone support or the fastest speed.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You run several small sites and want one plan for all of them.
You can commit to a long term, or you will use the 30-day refund to test.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You need phone support.
You want staging and a CDN on a budget plan.
Speed is your top priority.
meta.rl_r_pros:
25 websites and 25 GB NVMe on the cheapest plan.
Daily backups, free SSL and a free domain for the first year.
A 100% uptime guarantee with hosting credits.
Renewal prices shown next to first-term prices.
meta.rl_r_cons:
The cheapest price needs a 4-year term.
Renewal is 3.8 to 4.0 times the first price.
Email is free for 3 months only.
No staging or CDN on shared plans.
No phone support.
meta.rl_r_best: Several small WordPress sites on one plan
meta.rl_r_method:
Our own use | We do not host our own site on DreamHost, so this is a research-based review. We did not run our own tests
Pricing and plan limits | DreamHost's pricing page, plan pages and reviews page, read on 20 November 2026, with third-party checks from 7 November 2026 for the renewal and 4-year prices
Independent tests | WPBeginner (July 2026), hosttest.de (February 2026) and WPSchool (April 2026, on an older plan)
Competitor reviews | The top-ranking DreamHost reviews read for structure and questions: WPThinker, WPRoom, WPSchool, DigiOffly, ServerPicks and HostPull
Questions people ask | The questions the top pages answer in their headings, plus the questions people search for in Semrush, such as how many WordPress sites DreamHost hosts and whether it offers nonprofit hosting
When sources disagree | We show both numbers and say which we used. For the refund window we used DreamHost's current page (30 days), not older reviews (97 days)
Our calculations | The five-year cost table is our own arithmetic from DreamHost's prices
Freshness | Prices and offers are read again before this page goes live, and the page carries the date they were checked
What we did not do | We did not run our own speed or uptime test. Each test number is credited to the team that measured it

meta.rl_r_final: DreamHost gives you many small sites on one cheap plan and clear renewal prices. Choose the term carefully, budget for email after three months, and use the 30-day refund if it does not fit.
